newsitem.title: USA: American Industrial to post Q1 gain on debt.
newsitem.headline: American Industrial to post Q1 gain on debt.

text.p: American Industrial Properties REIT Thursday said it will post in the first quarter of 1997 an extraordinary gain of $2.6 million, or $0.26 per share, on early extinguishment of debt.
The company also said it restructured other debt. It said that major shareholder USAA Real Estate Co acquired the Trust's outstanding 8.8 percent notes from The Manufacturers Life Insurance Co.

Further, the notes have been modified to incorporate amendments, including extending the maturity of the notes to December 31, 2000, amending the principal balance of the notes from $9,419,213 to $7,040,721 and releasing all collateral securing the notes.
The Trust also made a $1,591,103 principal payment on the notes, resulting in a current principal balance on the notes of $5,449,618, American Industrial said.
